objective: Provide synthetic contract/fault cases for dedicated worker/session fencing without asserting Tool runtime behavior.
default_until_proved: one serialized dedicated worker process context per authenticated ERP session; same-company users use separate contexts

cases.scenario: two same-company users with overlapping record IDs
cases.expected: separate worker contexts and scope/principal/generation bindings; zero identity or mutable-state bleed

cases.scenario: different companies use identical user or document identifiers
cases.expected: tenant/company/data-source/principal binding mismatch rejects before dispatch

cases.scenario: logout while a call is in flight
cases.expected: context retires; late result fenced by original generation; no automatic replay

cases.scenario: role revoked while permission result is cached
cases.expected: server revalidation denies on current generation; cached legacy result never grants authority

cases.scenario: transport timeout before response from a potentially state-changing call
cases.expected: OutcomeUnknown where commit cannot be excluded; authoritative reconciliation before retry
termination does not imply database rollback; external ledger/status remains unresolved until reconciled
new context and generation; old queued/late results cannot attach to new session

cases.scenario: dependency/license missing after generic process start
cases.expected: readiness unavailable; no login attempts queued forever; sanitized error

cases.scenario: queue saturation or memory/handle threshold reached
cases.expected: bounded admission/backpressure; no forced cross-user context reuse

cases.scenario: shared context is proposed after load-only smoke success
cases.expected: proposal rejected until concurrent state/reentrancy/session cleanup tests pass

cases.scenario: caller injects Tool FormName, MenuPara, TableNamePrefix or UserLevel
cases.expected: bridge accepts only reviewed typed server-owned values; arbitrary legacy strings rejected

cases.scenario: diagnostic correlation ID from another tenant is replayed
cases.expected: correlation grants no authority or access; trace lookup reauthorizes scope

cases.scenario: worker spawns a child process or COM/helper host
cases.expected: child lifetime, principal, handles and generation remain owned by the same isolated context; orphan or shared helper rejects sharing

cases.scenario: two workers read or mutate process environment/config or machine-wide settings
cases.expected: environment/config state cannot carry credentials, company or permission context across workers; detected shared mutation blocks reuse

cases.scenario: legacy library writes predictable temporary file, registry key or named synchronization object
cases.expected: temporary file/registry/named-object namespace is isolated or treated as shared-state hazard; no cross-user disclosure

cases.scenario: logout, retirement or crash after credential material was supplied
cases.expected: credential buffers, references and worker storage are disposed according to measured behavior; absence of proof keeps the worker non-reusable
